data.headline: ISG Leader and CTO - Middle East and Africa

subComponents.title: Director of Business Development, Edge Computing and Telecom
subComponents.caption: Mar 2019 - Oct 2024 · 5 yrs 7 mos

description.text:
•	Lead a global team of Business Development professionals and Solution Architects.
•	Responsible for the development and go to market for Edge Computing & Telecom solutions.
•	Responsible for the development of Edge Computing partner eco system including Strategic Alliances and ISVs to build solutions. 
•	Develop E2E solutions that include 5G/MEC and ML/AI to address industry use cases such as Telco, Smart Cities, Retail, Manufacturing, Education and Healthcare.

experiences.title: Senior Director Business Development
experiences.subtitle: Nuage Networks from Nokia . Permanent Full-time
experiences.caption: Jan 2016 - Mar 2019 · 3 yrs 2 mos

description.text:
•	Responsible for the development, management, strategy, and go to market for service provider partners (SPaaP), resellers, and strategic alliances programs
•	Developed and executed a Distributor, Value Added Reseller, and Global System Integrator (GSI) partnership program from the ground. Closely collaborated with Legal and contract management to develop partner program agreements.
•	Provide feedback to Product Management teams on product requirements to ensure product readiness for commercial deployment. This activity also includes providing feedback to product development teams on technical or support issues such as feature deficiencies and product quality, documentation or ordering issues encountered with products during pre-sales activities.
•	Provide commercial and operational support to sales teams in developing proposals for deployment of SDN, SD-WAN, and cloud products and solutions.
•	Lead  the Go/No-Go process on RFx to determine response strategy, and support Bid Defenses.

•	Professional Services PLM (Product Line Management) and business development lead on SDN/SD-WAN and NFV service offerings.
•	Work closely with sales leads in all regions and provided RFX responses, bid defense support, professional services proposal and pricing. 
•	Identification, analysis and development of new services offerings.
•	Launch and marketing of new professional services offerings.
•	Develop custom offers for complex technical Professional Services engagements.

•	Lead engineer for various global accounts, providing Network Design Solutions worldwide including many T1 and T2 Telco.
•	Detailed knowledge of the Alcatel-Lucent IP product portfolio, as well as future direction of the product-lines.
•	Develop relationships with key customer decision makers on product placement and feature improvements becoming a trusted advisor.
•	Drive strategy on product positioning.
•	Lead customer requirements gathering workshops and make design recommendations based on best practices and customer needs.
•	Conduct strategic pre-sales presentations to customers based on their business requirements.
•	Network Design expertise in multi-vendor integration.

experiences.title: New Product Introduction Engineer
experiences.subtitle: Alcatel-Lucent (company no longer exists) . Permanent Full-time
experiences.caption: Jan 2002 - Jan 2005 · 3 yrs

description.text:
•	New Product Introduction for Alcatel Access Network Division.
•	Analyzed and integrated network management and network infrastructure solutions for major telecommunication accounts worldwide.
•	Worked on various global accounts, providing technical coverage worldwide.
•	This required detailed knowledge of the company's products and future direction as well as a strong understanding of the industry.
•	Developed and delivered product introduction presentations to customers and internal teams.
•	Provided network designs, equipment configurations, and network audits.
•	Provided on-site support for Alcatel's network management systems for major global carriers maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.

•	Designed and developed Network Management System features for Frame Relay, TDM, ATM, IP / MPLS, Broadband DSL, and IP DSL.
•	Derived R&D requirements from Product Line Management input; developed feature specifications explaining the requested customer functionality in depth.
•	Developed Implementation Plan of features; designed and executed test plans using both automation tools and manual procedures.
